description: Numerical settings of thermal design chapter 8 table 8 and chapter 7, run on the FE-001 mean environment case (nom0) through sdtwin_sim.coupled. The scenario block repeats the FE-001 inputs of tests/data/fe_001/fe001_config.json for the mean environment case; the test checks them against that file, the FE parameter table iss_fem/model/iss_spec.py and the FE orbit record iss_fem/out/nom0/summary.json. NI-001 adds a computing load start and stop on Compute01, the solver matrix, and one step that must be rejected.

scenario.source: FE-001 inputs for the mean environment case, from tests/data/fe_001/fe001_config.json: solar array from the FE parameter table iss_spec.py, SR with a very large resistance because the FE has no array to radiator conduction, auxiliary nodes J, C, B, D and R with explicit test values

load.source: NI-001 input: one computing load start and one stop inside the last orbit, both in sunlight and away from the eclipse boundaries and from the output grid; in the thermal-only FE-001 case the load is the prescribed P_load_W of Compute01 and its start and stop are declared input discontinuities of the coupled run

matrix.source: NI-001 inputs: RK45 and Radau; relative tolerance 1e-6 and 1e-8; temperature absolute tolerance 1e-6 K and 1e-8 K; maximum step 60 s and 10 s; output interval 10 s and 60 s; every combination is run once; eclipse scan step and event time tolerance as in FE-001

earth_flux_table.interpolation: not-a-knot cubic spline of each surface irradiance, clipped at zero
earth_flux_table.source: thermal design table 8: synchronized environment values with declared interpolation on continuous intervals and a declared input spacing; the samples are sdtwin_sim.earth_flux records with the FE-001 albedo, infrared, solar constant, Earth radius and quadrature resolution

exact_run.source: precondition run of the FE-001 mean environment case with the EarthFluxModel of FE-001, evaluated at every trial, used to show that the case runs and that the Earth-flux table represents it

rejected_step.source: NI-001 input: a first step of 60 s at the eclipse entry of the last orbit; its Dormand-Prince error norm is computed beforehand from the independent reference and is far above one, so the attempt must be rejected

reference.source: independent hand implementation of T2 to T5 integrated on the closed-form eclipse and load segments by a classical fourth order Runge-Kutta method written in the test support, with steps landing on whole seconds and on the 10 s knots of the Earth-flux spline; the half step run bounds the error of the reference
